description: Java service class for managing notes in a backend application, handling creation, retrieval, listing, updating, patching, and deletion of notes via a repository and exposing methods with transactional support.

classes.name: NoteService
classes.description: Service layer handling business logic for notes, including create, read, update, patch, delete functionalities, using NoteRepository for data access.

methods.name: create
methods.description: Creates a new note entry based on CreateNoteRequest and returns a NoteResponse.

methods.name: get
methods.description: Retrieves a note by its ID and returns a NoteResponse; throws exception if not found.

methods.name: list
methods.description: Lists notes with pagination, returning a page of NoteResponse.

methods.name: update
methods.description: Performs a full update of a note specified by ID, using UpdateNoteRequest.

methods.name: patch
methods.description: Performs a partial update (PATCH) on a note specified by ID using PatchNoteRequest.

methods.name: delete
methods.description: Deletes a note by its ID; throws exception if not found.
